title: Automotive Service Technician
description:
We are hiring an experienced Automotive Service Technician. Key Responsibilities:
- Perform routine maintenance, including oil changes, tire rotations, and brake inspections.
- Diagnose complex mechanical and electrical issues using diagnostic tools.
- Repair or replace defective parts and systems.
- Ensure all work meets quality and safety standards.
Requirements:
- High school diploma or equivalent; automotive training program preferred.
- ASE certification is a strong plus.
- Deep understanding of automotive systems and mechanics.
- Ability to handle heavy physical labor.
